size_rationale: Medium because the cause sits one step away from the symptom, in the validate middleware shared by every route; the per-route schemas the prompt leads to are correct.
prompt: Requests with missing or malformed query parameters are no longer rejected: POST /v1/auth/verify-email and POST /v1/auth/reset-password without `?token=` now return 401 instead of a 400 validation error, and GET /v1/users?limit=abc returns 200. Invalid request bodies are still rejected with 400.

root_cause.detail: The validate middleware only picks ['params', 'body'] from each route schema, so every route's query schema is silently ignored.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/verify-email > should return 400 if verify email token is missing
tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/reset-password > should return 400 if reset password token is missing
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/auth.test.js -t 'should return 400 if verify email token is missing|should return 400 if reset password token is missing'
